rationale: Initial values chosen by reasoning (precision first) before any evaluation; deliberately left untuned. prior_odds is the assumed odds that a blocked candidate pair is a true match (about 1 in 11). fs_naive is the spec-literal Fellegi-Sunter: independent features and three overrides.

Chosen from eval_threshold_sweep (ADR-003). t_auto 0.997: precision on final clusters rises from 0.99966 to 0.99986 and false merged pairs fall from 5 to 2 at the cost of 3 extra review items (112 to 115). t_review 0.85: recall is flat at 0.9996 from 0.50 to 0.999 (the 6 missed pairs are guard casualties no threshold recovers), so a lower t_review only adds queue noise: 0.85 cuts the queue from 112 to 48 items. prior_odds is unchanged from the initial assumption.
